info.title: Vivacity Execution Runtime
info.description: Robotics-only runtime: measured Panda manipulation, reaching and experimental fixture-assisted flex folding. Public scenario templates declare readiness and reject unsupported combinations. Single-process demo.

/v1/experiments/{experiment_id}/events.description: Persisted progress; reconnect with after=<seq>; closes on terminal event. Session worlds require capability via vivacity.token.<token> WebSocket subprotocol.

/v1/experiments/{experiment_id}/live.description: Latest measured authoritative simulation state, maximum 20 Hz, no replay. Capability subprotocol required for session-owned worlds. Slow clients skip intermediate frames.
